http.description: Proxy URL to use for HTTP requests, including the port number.

https.description: Proxy URL to use for HTTPS requests, including the port number.

stream.description: Whether to stream the download of the response. If False, the response content will be immediately downloaded. Streaming is useful for handling large files or responses.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not. Set to False to skip certificate verification, which is not recommended unless you are sure of the server's identity.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑start guide to a handful of public (or freemium) APIs that accept an IP address and return **company‑level data**—including the organization name, domain, and, where available, contact details such as email addresses, phone numbers, or a corporate website. | API | Key Features | Free Tier | Typical Response | How to Call | |-----|--------------|-----------|------------------|-------------| | **ipinfo.io** | `org`, `hostname`, `company` fields; optional `company` sub‑object with `name`, `domain`, `email`, `phone` | 50 k requests/month (no key) | 
{ "ip":"8.8.8.8","org":"AS15169 Google LLC","company":{"name":"Google LLC","domain":"google.com","email":"support@google.com","phone":"+1-650-253-0000"}}
| `https://ipinfo.io//json?token=` | | **ipapi.co** | `org`, `company`, `domain`, `email`, `phone` | 30 k requests/month (no key) | 
{ "ip":"8.8.8.8","org":"AS15169 Google LLC","company":"Google LLC","domain":"google.com","email":"support@google.com","phone":"+1-650-253-0000"}
| `https://ipapi.co//json/` | | **ipstack.com** | `organization`, `domain`, `company_name`, `company_website`, `company_email`, `company_phone` | 10 k requests/month (free key) | 
{ "ip":"8.8.8.8","organization":"Google LLC","company_name":"Google LLC","company_website":"https://www.google.com","company_email":"support@google.com","company_phone":"+1-650-253-0000"}
| `https://api.ipstack.com/?access_key=` | | **ipgeolocation.io** | `organization`, `domain`, `company_name`, `company_website`, `company_email`, `company_phone` | 1 k requests/day (free key) | 
{ "ip":"8.8.8.8","organization":"Google LLC","company_name":"Google LLC","company_website":"https://www.google.com","company_email":"support@google.com","company_phone":"+1-650-253-0000"}
| `https://api.ipgeolocation.io/ipgeo?apiKey=&ip=` | | **ipdata.co** | `organization`, `domain`, `company_name`, `company_website`, `company_email`, `company_phone` | 1 k requests/day (free key) | 
{ "ip":"8.8.8.8","organization":"Google LLC","company_name":"Google LLC","company_website":"https://www.google.com","company_email":"support@google.com","company_phone":"+1-650-253-0000"}
| `https://api.ipdata.co/?api-key=` | | **ipwhois.io** | `org`, `domain`, `email`, `phone` | 10 k requests/month (free key) | 
{ "ip":"8.8.8.8","org":"AS15169 Google LLC","domain":"google.com","email":"support@google.com","phone":"+1-650-253-0000"}
| `https://ipwhois.app/json/` | | **ip2location.com** | `org`, `domain`, `company_name`, `company_website`, `company_email`, `company_phone` | 1 k requests/day (free key) | 
{ "ip":"8.8.8.8","org":"Google LLC","company_name":"Google LLC","company_website":"https://www.google.com","company_email":"support@google.com","company_phone":"+1-650-253-0000"}
| `https://api.ip2location.com/v2/?key=&ip=&format=json` | --- ## Quick Python Example (using `requests`) ```python import requests def get_company_info(ip, api='ipinfo'): if api == 'ipinfo': token = 'YOUR_TOKEN' # optional for free tier url = f'https://ipinfo.io/{ip}/json?token={token}' elif api == 'ipapi': url = f'https://ipapi.co/{ip}/json/' elif api == 'ipstack': key = 'YOUR_KEY' url = f'https://api.ipstack.com/{ip}?access_key={key}' # add more branches as needed resp = requests.get(url, timeout=5) resp.raise_for_status() data = resp.json() # Pull out the company block if it exists company = data.get('company') or data.get('company_name') return { 'ip': data.get('ip'), 'org': data.get('org') or data.get('organization'), 'domain': data.get('domain'), 'company_name': company, 'company_website': data.get('company_website') or data.get('website'), 'company_email': data.get('company_email') or data.get('email'), 'company_phone': data.get('company_phone') or data.get('phone') } # Example usage print(get_company_info('8.8.8.8', api='ipinfo')) ``` --- ## Things to Keep in Mind | Issue | What to Watch For | |-------|-------------------| | **Rate limits** | Most free tiers cap at 10–50 k requests/month. If you need higher volume, upgrade or rotate keys. | | **Data freshness** | Some providers update their company database weekly; others daily. | | **Privacy & compliance** | Avoid sending personal IPs that could be tied to individuals. Check GDPR / CCPA implications. | | **Contact availability** | Not all IPs belong to a company or have public contact info. Expect `null` or missing fields. | | **API key security** | Store keys in environment variables or secret managers; never hard‑code them in public repos. | --- ### Bottom Line If you just need a quick, free lookup, **ipinfo.io** or **ipapi.co** are the easiest to start with. For richer data (especially contact details) and higher request volumes, consider **ipstack.com**, **ipgeolocation.io**, or **ipdata.co**—all of which offer a generous free tier and a straightforward JSON payload that includes company name, domain, email, phone, and website.
